scripts.create:public:windows: mkdir public && mkdir public\donate && mkdir public\projects
scripts.create:public:linux:darwin: mkdir -p public && mkdir -p public/donate && mkdir -p public/projects
scripts.copy:pages:windows: copy /y html\donate.html public\donate\index.html && copy /y html\projects.html public\projects\index.html
scripts.copy:pages:linux:darwin: cp -r html/donate.html public/donate/index.html && cp -r html/projects.html public/projects/index.html
scripts.cleanup:html:windows: del /q public\donate.html && del /q public\projects.html && del /q public\notfound.html
scripts.cleanup:html:linux:darwin: rm -rf public/donate.html && rm -rf public/projects.html && rm -rf public/notfound.html
scripts.build:windows: npm run copy:pages && npm run minify:css && npm run minify:html && npm run cleanup:html
scripts.build:linux:darwin: npm run create:public && npm run copy:pages && npm run minify:css && npm run minify:html && npm run cleanup:html
